cases.instruction: In evals/runner/compare_runs.py, make score summaries interpret only the literal boolean True as a passed task. Strings such as 'false', 'yes', and '0' must never count as success. Preserve valid boolean results and public interfaces. Edit only this module; do not modify tests, fixtures, or verifiers.

In scripts/verify_holdout_dataset.py, fail the train/eval integrity verdict when a supplied manifest's counts, task distribution, prompt-family distribution or domain distribution disagree with recomputed JSONL contents. Preserve correctly matched reports and exit codes. Edit only this script; no changes to data or tests.

In evals/runner/run_eval.py, eliminate the risk of reporting generated-model pass rates using reference answers when a --candidate-map omits task IDs. In candidate-map mode, every task must use a supplied candidate or explicitly fail; a complete candidate map must score normally. Preserve reference-only runs without --candidate-map. Edit only this runner.
